name: Chaos Labyrinth
source:
When he woke up, he was in a room he didn't know.
The only light in that room was the moonlight coming from the window.
When he raised the upper part of his body, the body creaked as if he had been bedridden for a long time.

He didn't know what place it was.
He didn't know who he was.
He couldn't remember his name.

When, bearing the pain, he descended from the bed, the dust, thinly piled up, was whirled up.
When he went outside, that place looked like a section of a castle somewhere.
But nearby there was nobody and at the windows there weren't lights.
Only, in the far zenith, the full moon was shining.

Suddenly a restless chill took possession of him.
The world was softly distorted, the sound of a bell reaching him from far behind resounded in his head.
How much time had passed? The chill and the sound of the bell had already gone away.
To take their place, in front of his eyes there was someone's shadow.
But ... it had something fantastic.

[Translated from [url=http://www.debonosu.jp/debonosu/game/cl/story.html]Official Page[/url]]

Chaos Labyrinth is an old-school dungeon crawler, which also means that it’s a grindfest. The monsters are actually girls from your school and defeating them (and having sex with them) reveals their past. You need to defeat the same girl many times in order to temporarily turn her back to normal, although that requires you to return to the start point and lose all skills you had accrued to that point. You also can’t have more than one girl back to normal at any given time.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/12/01/december-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
他醒来时，发现自己身处一间陌生房间。房间里唯一的光线，是从窗户照进来的月光。他撑起上半身，身体发出吱嘎声，仿佛已经卧床很久。

他不知道这里是什么地方，不知道自己是谁，也想不起自己的名字。

忍着疼痛下床时，薄薄积起的灰尘被扬到空中。走出房间后，他发现这里像是某座城堡的一角。然而附近空无一人，窗户里也没有灯光，只有远处天顶的满月在发光。

突然，一阵不安的寒意攫住了他。世界轻轻扭曲，远处传来的钟声在脑中回响。究竟过去了多久？寒意与钟声很快消失，取而代之的是眼前出现的某个人影。

但那影子……有着非凡的形态。

[译自[url=http://www.debonosu.jp/debonosu/game/cl/story.html]官方页面[/url]]

《Chaos Labyrinth》是一款复古风格的迷宫探索游戏，也意味着需要反复刷怪升级。怪物其实是你学校里的女孩，击败她们并与她们发生关系后，便能了解她们的过去。你必须多次击败同一个女孩，才能暂时让她恢复正常；但要做到这一点，你必须回到起点，失去此前积累的全部技能。而且，同一时间最多只能让一名女孩恢复正常。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/12/01/december-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
